description: The 'approved' finish condition: after assembly, screen; while the punch list is non-empty and the film is not ship-ready, draft the work order, realize it, re-assemble and screen again; stop when the judge has no further comments or the cap or round limit is reached, and say which. Composes screening, work order, iterate and dailies; the new thing is the loop and its stopping rule.
researcher_question: Does the judge have anything left to say, and what did each round change?
